data.long_meaning: The name Latisha is of English origin, derived from the Latin name 'Late'. It means 'late' or 'elegant'. In Christian and biblical tradition, Latisha may symbolize the late arrival of a blessing or the elegance of God's creation. The name Latisha carries the meaning “Late, elegant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Latisha usually hope their child will grow to embody late, elegant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
